STOR.description: Auto Generate Story (STOR). Reads all model nodes to auto-detect story levels, then generates story data; the request fields only control whether accidental seismic/wind eccentricity is applied and by what percentage.

Argument.description: Request body controlling accidental eccentricity used during automatic story generation.

SEIS_ECC.description: Seismic accidental eccentricity settings. When INC_SEIS_ECC is true, each story's seismic eccentricity is computed as building width * SEIS_ECC_VALUE / 100.

INC_SEIS_ECC.description: Include Seismic Eccentricity: if true, apply accidental seismic eccentricity to each generated story.

SEIS_ECC_VALUE.description: Seismic Eccentricity (%). Must be non-negative; used as a percentage of the story width. Ignored when INC_SEIS_ECC is false.

WIND_ECC.description: Wind accidental eccentricity settings. When INC_WIND_ECC is true, each story's wind eccentricity is computed as building width * WIND_ECC_VALUE / 100.

INC_WIND_ECC.description: Include Wind Eccentricity: if true, apply accidental wind eccentricity to each generated story.

WIND_ECC_VALUE.description: Wind Eccentricity (%). Must be non-negative; used as a percentage of the story width. Ignored when INC_WIND_ECC is false.
